cohort: Nulliparous mothers aged 18 to 35 years, who referred to healthcare centers in Sanandaj, the capital city of Kurdistan province, Iran.
finding: While both vaginal and caesarean delivery resulted in reduced sexual function at 6 months postpartum, sexual function scores were higher in the caesarean delivery group at 6 months and this group had higher levels of sexual desire at 12 months.
mod_finding: Sexual function scores were higher in the caesarean delivery group at 6 months postpartum and this group had higher levels of sexual desire at 12 months postpartum.
